coverageKind: Complete unique-case coverage assembled from executed checkpoints
qualification: This is mixed-checkpoint evidence, including earlier implementation snapshots and later targeted verification of changes. It does not claim that an interrupted, cancelled or failed whole-suite process completed successfully. Individual native passed results from RPC-affected processes were matched to their exact verbose completed cases; original process failures and runner errors remain recorded.
